description: This file contains tests for the React App component of a Tic Tac Toe web application, utilizing React Testing Library and Jest for unit testing, including mocks for local storage and DOM interactions.

methods.name: beforeEach
methods.description: Sets up a mock for window.localStorage to be used before each test case.

methods.name: test
methods.description: Defines individual test cases for various functionalities of the App component, such as rendering elements, handling local storage, simulating game moves, and verifying storage updates.
